atoms.text: Josy says: “I enjoy living in the countryside because there is a lot of nature and more space. Here, my family has a house with our own garden. We spend a lot of time there. For instance, we often have barbecues in the summer. There is even a huge forest nearby. I often go on a hike with friends, my parents or alone. I really like that there is not much traffic and that it's usually very quiet.”

atoms.text: Brody says: “I really like to live in a rural area and I want to continue living here when I am older. That's because in the countryside people usually know their neighbours and that is often not the case in big cities. We greet each other when we see one another on the streets. We have a friendly and calm neighbourhood. I won't leave here.”

atoms.text: Inaya says: “Currently, I live in the country, but I'm not staying here. After graduating from high school, I will move to an urban area. We have a family business here. However, that doesn't keep me from leaving our village. My sister is going to take over the family business, since she is happy here. The countryside is just too quiet for my taste.”
